query:
SELECT
                user_id,
                major,
                routine_minor AS "minor!",
                routine_id AS "routine_id!",
                routine_fills AS "fills!",
                routine_task_hash AS "task_hash!"
            FROM marketplace_install
            WHERE listing_id = $1
              AND major = $2
              AND routine_minor < $3
              AND routine_id IS NOT NULL
              AND detached_at IS NULL
